name: Transmute Rock And Mud

outcomes.criticalSuccess: The creature escapes the mud and is atop the stone, unaffected.
outcomes.success: The creature climbs out of the mud as it turns to rock and is prone atop the stone.
outcomes.failure: The creature is partially stuck in the mud and is grabbed for 1 round or until it Escapes, whichever comes first.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The creature is entirely stuck. It is restrained for 1 round or until it Escapes, whichever comes first.

heightening.text: Add an additional 10-foot cube to the area, adjacent to at least one of the other cubes.

entries: You warp the structure of earthen material, turning rock into mud or mud into rock. Choose one of these two options when you Cast the Spell.
If creatures are in the mud when it is transformed to stone, they must attempt a Reflex saving throw.
